method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module, the rules in one module and the claimant's questions in a seat module importing it; one regulative rule (the time bar) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation Act 2005 (WA), No. 19 of 2005, compilation including No. 3 of 2018, No. 21 of 2023 and No. 32 of 2024, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/mrdoc_47979.txt (committed text sha256 b194c75ddd3b6d857717269fa9b66fa78b48df23dd556085a5463ae4844ea48e), retrieved from legislation.wa.gov.au on 2026-09-07

seat: the claimant: the individual to whom a cause of action accrues and who brings or proposes to bring the action (injured person, worker with a dust disease, survivor of child sexual abuse, family member suing for a death, party to a contract or deed) (la-seat.l4); the s 81 question is asked by the same individual answering a claim with a counterclaim

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run la-dates.l4 ; l4 run la-rules.l4 ; l4 run la-seat.l4 ; l4 run la-cases.l4
checks.result: 145 assertions written, 145 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets, including the child sexual abuse and dust disease provisions. In: ss 4(1), 6, 6A, 6B, 7, 12(1), 13, 14, 16, 17, 18, 30-33, 35, 36, 38, 39, 41, 42, 45, 46(1)(a), (b), 47-50, 52, 53, 55, 56, 57, 79, 81, 89-92 (ss 43, 44, 58, 91(4), (5), 92(4)-(6) and the defamation exclusions in descriptions). Out: ss 1-3, 5, 6A(7), (8), 8, 9 (in a description), 10-12(2) (machinery, transitional, other Acts); ss 15, 40 (defamation); ss 19-29, 46(1)(c), 51, 54, 59-78, 80, 82-88 (land, mortgages, trusts, accounts, equity, tax, arbitration). Reasons in NOTES.md.
